title: Query count after three-query conversion
statement: Let $n\ge 1$, let $P$ be a property of Boolean words of length $n$, and let a PCPP description for $P$ have positive query count. The associated three-query PCPP description has query count $3$.
hypotheses_covered: A PCPP description for a property $P$ of Boolean words of length $n$.
The description's query count is positive.
